title: NextScholar ASEAN Scholarship English preparation curriculum
audience: Secondary-school students in Indonesia and Southeast Asia preparing for ASEAN Scholarship selection tests.
evidence_boundary: Preparation curriculum based on candidate-reported format and literacy research; configurable details remain provisional until corroborated.

exam_blueprint.title: Language use and comprehension
exam_blueprint.format: Sentence vocabulary, banked cloze, open cloze and two reading passages.

exam_blueprint.title: Writing
exam_blueprint.format: One composition reported at approximately 300 words.

modules.title: Orientation, baseline and error language
modules.purpose: Establish a trustworthy starting point and teach learners how to use feedback.

lessons.title: Know the paper
lessons.outcome: Identify the purpose, format and timing of every reported test part without treating provisional counts as official facts.

lessons.title: Baseline objective check
lessons.outcome: Complete an untutored, mixed diagnostic covering vocabulary, grammar/cloze and reading.

lessons.title: Diagnose the mistake
lessons.outcome: Classify errors by knowledge, reasoning, attention and time rather than recording only right or wrong.

modules.title: Vocabulary that transfers
modules.purpose: Build word knowledge and strategies for reasoning about unfamiliar words.

lessons.title: Meaning from local context
lessons.outcome: Use definitions, examples, contrast, cause and tone around a word to test a possible meaning.

lessons.title: Word class and word family
lessons.outcome: Use noun, verb, adjective and adverb forms to eliminate grammatically impossible options.

lessons.title: Roots and affixes
lessons.outcome: Use common prefixes, roots and suffixes as evidence without assuming they always determine the whole meaning.

lessons.title: Synonym precision
lessons.outcome: Distinguish denotation, strength and connotation among near-synonyms.

lessons.title: Collocation and register
lessons.outcome: Select words that naturally combine and fit formal, neutral or informal contexts.

lessons.title: Unknown-word protocol
lessons.outcome: Combine syntax, context, morphology and option elimination under a short time limit.

modules.title: Sentence control and cohesion
modules.purpose: Make the grammar needed for cloze and writing visible and usable.

lessons.title: Sentence and clause boundaries
lessons.outcome: Recognise complete clauses, fragments, run-ons and relationships between clauses.

lessons.title: Agreement and reference
lessons.outcome: Control subject–verb agreement, pronoun agreement and clear antecedents.

lessons.title: Time and viewpoint
lessons.outcome: Select tense and aspect from the passage timeline and maintain consistency.

lessons.title: Noun phrases
lessons.outcome: Use articles, determiners, quantity and countability accurately.

lessons.title: Prepositions and patterns
lessons.outcome: Choose common preposition, verb-complement and adjective-complement patterns in context.

lessons.title: Logical connections
lessons.outcome: Use conjunctions, transitions and relative structures to express contrast, cause, condition, addition and sequence.

modules.title: Banked story cloze
modules.purpose: Solve a coherent passage with more candidate words than gaps.

lessons.title: Read the whole story first
lessons.outcome: Track setting, characters, chronology, conflict and tone before filling gaps.

lessons.title: Apply the grammar filter
lessons.outcome: Use the words around a blank to identify the required word class and form.

lessons.title: Apply the meaning filter
lessons.outcome: Compare collocation, connotation and local meaning among grammatically possible words.

lessons.title: Solve globally
lessons.outcome: Reconsider earlier choices as the remaining bank and whole-passage coherence change the evidence.

modules.title: Open cloze without a word bank
modules.purpose: Infer missing function words, forms and lexical items from local and global evidence.

lessons.title: Function-word gaps
lessons.outcome: Supply articles, pronouns, auxiliaries, prepositions and conjunctions from sentence structure.

lessons.title: Form and agreement gaps
lessons.outcome: Infer the required tense, number, comparison or derived word form.

lessons.title: Collocation and lexical gaps
lessons.outcome: Retrieve a content word or fixed expression that fits the passage meaning.

lessons.title: Cohesion across sentences
lessons.outcome: Use reference chains, repetition, contrast and chronology beyond the immediate sentence.

lessons.title: Timed open cloze
lessons.outcome: Apply a first-pass, second-pass and final-read method to a complete passage.

modules.title: Reading comprehension and reference
modules.purpose: Read efficiently, track reference and support answers with bounded textual evidence.

lessons.title: Build a passage map
lessons.outcome: Identify topic, paragraph purpose, development and text structure without over-annotating.

lessons.title: Track reference chains
lessons.outcome: Resolve what pronouns, demonstratives and descriptive phrases refer to.

lessons.title: Meaning and synonym in context
lessons.outcome: Replace a word with a meaning that preserves its sense and grammatical role in that sentence.

lessons.title: Retrieve stated evidence
lessons.outcome: Locate and paraphrase explicit information accurately.

lessons.title: Make bounded inferences
lessons.outcome: Combine textual clues without importing unsupported assumptions.

lessons.title: Purpose, tone and main idea
lessons.outcome: Distinguish the writer’s central purpose, attitude and supporting details.

lessons.title: Two-passage pacing
lessons.outcome: Allocate time, mark uncertain items and preserve a checking buffer across both passages.

modules.title: From prompt to organised response
modules.purpose: Turn a prompt into a relevant, ordered and manageable plan.

lessons.title: Decode the task
lessons.outcome: Identify topic, command, audience, scope and any required personal application.

lessons.title: Generate usable ideas
lessons.outcome: Produce relevant examples rapidly using experience, observation, school learning and plausible scenarios.

lessons.title: Choose and order
lessons.outcome: Select two or three developable ideas instead of listing many shallow points.

lessons.title: Build the controlling focus
lessons.outcome: Write a clear central response that every paragraph advances.

lessons.title: Plan in five minutes
lessons.outcome: Produce a compact introduction–body–conclusion plan with examples and transitions.

modules.title: Paragraphs, evidence and cohesion
modules.purpose: Develop controlled paragraphs with specific support and purposeful connections.

lessons.title: Paragraph purpose
lessons.outcome: Give each paragraph one controlling point or narrative function.

lessons.title: Develop with specifics
lessons.outcome: Explain significance and use precise examples, actions, observations or consequences.

lessons.title: Cohesion without formula
lessons.outcome: Connect ideas through reference, logical sequence and selective transitions rather than repetitive stock phrases.

lessons.title: Introductions and endings
lessons.outcome: Open directly, establish direction and conclude by resolving the response rather than repeating it mechanically.

lessons.title: Read like a writer
lessons.outcome: Analyse an original model and transfer one structural move into a new paragraph.

modules.title: Accurate and effective essay language
modules.purpose: Improve precision, sentence control and high-value editing habits.

lessons.title: Precise vocabulary
lessons.outcome: Replace vague or repetitive words with accurate choices that fit the meaning and register.

lessons.title: Sentence variety with control
lessons.outcome: Combine and vary sentences without introducing fragments, agreement errors or unclear reference.

lessons.title: Show relationships
lessons.outcome: Express cause, contrast, qualification, sequence and consequence explicitly.

lessons.title: Edit by priority
lessons.outcome: Check task fulfilment and organisation before grammar, spelling and punctuation.

lessons.title: Personal error log
lessons.outcome: Identify two recurring error patterns and apply a short correction routine.

modules.title: Essay forms and 30-minute performance
modules.purpose: Apply the writing process to likely forms under the reported time limit.

lessons.title: Reflective and personal expository writing
lessons.outcome: Connect experience or school learning to a clear insight, explanation or application.

lessons.title: Narrative writing
lessons.outcome: Shape setting, conflict, purposeful detail, turning point and resolution where a narrative prompt is offered.

lessons.title: Opinion and discursive writing
lessons.outcome: State a defensible position, develop reasons and acknowledge relevant complexity.

lessons.title: Compress the process
lessons.outcome: Move from 45-minute supported writing to 35-minute and then 30-minute independent writing.

lessons.title: Full English simulation
lessons.outcome: Complete Section 1 and Section 2 under their separate reported limits, with no hints or immediate marking.
